expected.finding: **[P2]** `scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py`: Restoration candidates and rollback checks use different evidence windows. `weight_repair()` and the final candidate check evaluate all archive entries, while rollback uses `entries_covered_by_evidence()`. Later findings can therefore make a restoration pass even though it worsens validity on the snapshot-covered rounds; after two stamped rounds, the unchanged snapshot causes a rollback. Use the same evidence-covered entries for candidate acceptance and rollback.

**[P2]** `scripts/render-rsi-dashboard.py`: `echo_note` inserts `anchor_note` without HTML escaping, including evidence-file `source` and `agents` strings. When verifier evidence is present—as configured in this workflow—HTML in those fields becomes executable content in the generated dashboard. Escape `anchor_note` here, as the other sections already do.

+    """Archive entries from rounds no later than the evidence snapshot's
+    collection time. Without a collection time, all entries."""
+    collected_ms = measure_mod.parse_timestamp_ms(
+        (measurement.get("anchor") or {}).get("collected_at")
+    )
+    if collected_ms is None:
+        return entries
+    covered_rounds = {
+        r["round"]
+        for r in measure_mod.rounds_in_order(entries)
+        if r["timestamp_ms"] is not None and r["timestamp_ms"] <= collected_ms
+    }
+    return [e for e in entries if e.get("round") in covered_rounds]
